name: Maple Dijon Chicken with Mushroom & Quinoa Risotto

instructions.primary_message: In a small saucepan, combine quinoa, broth, and water; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups quinoa
531 ml (2 ¼ cups) chicken or vegetable broth
¾ cup water

instructions.primary_message: Place chicken thighs in a baking dish.

Peel and mince garlic. In a medium bowl, mix together ½ of the garlic (save the rest for the mushrooms), maple syrup, Dijon, vinegar, rosemary, salt, and pepper. Pour over top chicken and turn to coat.
instructions.secondary_message:
9 cloves garlic
6 tbsp pure maple syrup
6 tbsp Dijon mustard
1 ½ tbsp rice vinegar
1 ½ tsp rosemary
¾ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place in the oven and roast until chicken is cooked through, 15-20 minutes. Scoop sauce over chicken halfway though.
Wash, dry, and thinly slice mushrooms.
Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add garlic and cook until fragrant, 15-30 seconds. Add mushrooms and season with rosemary, salt, and pepper. Stirring occasionally, cook until tender, 3-5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
about 3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp rosemary
⅜ tsp salt
3 pinches black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add broth to mushrooms and cook until liquid thickens, 2-3 minutes. Add spinach and stir until wilted. Then stir in quinoa and Parmesan.
instructions.secondary_message:
177 ml (¾ cup) chicken or vegetable broth
1 ½ (142 g) pkg baby spinach

instructions.primary_message: To serve, place risotto on a plate and top with chicken. Enjoy!
